# Digi Vidyarthi

> Digi Vidyarthi is Varanasi's premier digital marketing institute offering 100% practical, mentor-led offline training, live client campaigns, industry certifications, and 95% placement assistance.

## Core Information
- **Website:** [digividyarthi.com](https://digividyarthi.com/)
- **Location:** Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India
- **Batch Size:** Capped at 15 students per batch for personalized 1-on-1 mentorship.
- **Contact Email:** Info@digividyarthi.com
- **Contact Helpline:** +91-9278027950 | +91-9278039576
- **Placement Rate:** 95% verified success rate.
- **Google Rating:** 5.0 / 5.0 (based on student reviews).
